data.define: Used to react when something is awkward, embarrassing or a bad idea.

misuse.text: Don't tell your host 'big yikes' about dinner.

data.l1_hook: Socks dengan sandal? Serius? big yikes

native.tip: “big yikes” = wah, yikes. Contoh: “Socks with sandals? Big yikes.”
native.caption:
